items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...if you take a thing like Stopping at the Savoy, Christopher Columbu, all these things had a -- they at least had a sort of riff that you'd whistle or hum. [INTERVIEWEE] Simple.

ctx.x: And I hear it on the jukebox and can't wait until
they're coming down to hear them playing it in person. That was my side of it.

Well, you know, if you take the big numbers of that period -- I mean if you take a thing like Stopping at the Savoy, Christopher Columbu, all these things had a -- they at least had a sort of riff that you'd whistle or hum.
